1. Introduction

By accessing digitaltalha.com and working with DigitalTalha, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully before starting a project.

2. Services Provided

DigitalTalha provides digital marketing services, specifically focusing on:

  • Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)
  • Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Campaign planning, tracking setup, and ongoing optimization

3. No Guarantees on Results

While I use industry-standard practices and data-driven strategies to run your campaigns, digital marketing involves unpredictable factors (market changes, competitor actions, platform algorithm updates). Therefore, I cannot guarantee specific outcomes, such as a set number of leads, sales, or an exact return on investment (ROI).

4. Ad Spend and Payments

  • Ad Budget: You are strictly responsible for funding your own ad accounts. Ad spend is paid directly by you to Google or Meta.
  • Service Fees: DigitalTalha charges a separate fee for campaign setup and management. This fee does not include your ad spend.

5. Client Responsibilities

To ensure campaigns run smoothly, clients must:

  • Provide timely access to necessary accounts (Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, Website, GA4).
  • Provide accurate business information, images, and offers for ad creatives.
  • Respond to approval requests or questions in a reasonable timeframe.

6. Intellectual Property

All content on this website (digitaltalha.com), including text, layout, and images, is owned by DigitalTalha. You may not copy, reproduce, or use this content without explicit permission.

7. Limitation of Liability

DigitalTalha is not liable for any direct, indirect, or incidental damages, including lost profits or business interruptions, that result from the use of my services or account suspensions initiated by Google or Meta.
